archiveTitle: Daily Brief | 雨のちハレ女: Game Freak announces Ame Nochi Hareonna

entries.headline: 雨のちハレ女: Game Freak Announces Mobile Game Ame Nochi Hareonna for This Winter
entries.summary: Game Freak has announced the free-to-play mobile game Ame Nochi Hareonna. Set in modern Japan, it follows magical girls who turn weather into magic to lift people's spirits, and is planned for iOS and Android this winter.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON, 4Gamer, and Famitsu independently support the announcement, platforms, free-to-play model, and winter release window.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight Details Mayhem Collection DLC
entries.summary: The Mayhem Collection DLC will let players control The Joker and Harley Quinn, escape Arkham, build a customizable villain hideout, and recruit a crew, raid stores, and fight A.R.G.U.S. and Task Force X in the time-limited Mayhem Mode.
entries.verification: The first-party Xbox Wire developer article supports the characters, hideout, and mode details; the packet does not provide a release date for the DLC.
entries.timeNote: Xbox Wire's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: 人形の影：ピヨリタの物語: Ningyo no Kage: Piyorita no Monogatari Announced for PC and Consoles in 2027
entries.summary: KIWIWALKS has announced a 3D story-driven action RPG that inherits the world of the WitchSpring series and follows the doll Piyorita as she absorbs other dolls in pursuit of becoming the finished creation.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON and 4Gamer independently support the announcement, 2027 window, and PC/console scope; no specific consoles are inferred.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: SCP Foundation / V/H/S: SCP: SCP Wiki Says the V/H/S: SCP Film Team Did Not Contact It in Advance
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that after news of A24's involvement in V/H/S: SCP, the official SCP Wiki said it had received no consultation or contact from the film team and highlighted the CC BY-SA license governing the material.
entries.verification: Only AUTOMATON was opened in the packet, not the SCP Wiki statement or a studio page, so all claims remain attributed to the report.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: スーパーダンガンロンパ２×２: Super Danganronpa 2x2 Will Revise Its PC Recommended Specifications
entries.summary: According to AUTOMATON’s relay of producer Shohei Sakakibara, the current PC recommendation assumes 4K high-quality settings and will be updated; he also said the Nintendo Switch version has been optimized for that platform.
entries.verification: The report directly attributes the clarification to the producer; media comparisons are not treated as facts.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Marathon Delays Its Major Update to December 8 and Shifts Toward Permanent PvE Content
entries.summary: IGN relays Bungie's announcement that the major update planned for September 22 will arrive December 8 with permanent PvE content, a social space, and an experimental TDM mode. A smaller October 6 update will reset progression and the in-game economy.
entries.verification: The update schedule is explicitly attributed to Bungie; broader speculation in the report is excluded.
entries.timeNote: IGN's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls Director Apologizes for PC Launch Issues
entries.summary: IGN reports that director Kazuto Sekine acknowledged and apologized for PC stability problems and said the team is working on improvements, including changes to input handling and balance.
entries.verification: Only statements directly quoted or clearly attributed to the director are used.
entries.timeNote: IGN's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Co-op Survival Horror Game Feed the Fire Announced
entries.summary: Magellan Tide Games has announced the first-person survival horror game Feed the Fire. Players explore a forest, gather resources, and fortify their camp by day, then defend against creatures at night, alone or in co-op for up to four players.
entries.verification: The packet opened only AUTOMATON, not a developer or store page, so the item is presented as a media relay of the announcement.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: PICROSS S CLIMAX Announced for Switch 2 and Switch on December 10
entries.summary: Jupiter has announced PICROSS S CLIMAX, compiling 1,020 selected puzzles from PICROSS S through PICROSS S9 plus 40 high-difficulty bonus puzzles unlocked through series save data.
entries.verification: The date, platforms, counts, and unlock condition are taken from AUTOMATON's relay of the announcement.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: HORI Arcade Classic Pro for Nintendo Switch 2: HORI Announces Arcade Classic Pro Controller with Swappable Input Units
entries.summary: HORI has announced the officially licensed HORI Arcade Classic Pro for Nintendo Switch 2 for Switch 2, Switch, and PC. It supports four swappable input-unit types including a stick and trackball and is designed for the Arcade Archives series.
entries.verification: The product scope, licensing, order period, and price are taken from AUTOMATON's report of the announcement.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Rayman Legends Retold Delayed to December 3
entries.summary: IGN relays Ubisoft's announcement that Rayman Legends Retold, previously due October 1, has moved to December 3 for additional polish despite going gold. Another look is scheduled for September 22.
entries.verification: The delay, reason, and showcase date are explicitly attributed to Ubisoft.
entries.timeNote: IGN's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: GungHo Announces 30-Player Co-op PvE Shooter B.L.U.E. NOVA
entries.summary: GungHo has announced the free-to-play online co-op PvE shooter B.L.U.E. NOVA for PC in 2027. Players can form temporary R.I.N.G. links on the battlefield and join large fights with up to 30 players.
entries.verification: The packet opened only AUTOMATON, not a first-party page, so the item remains a media relay of the announcement.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Roguelite City Builder The Crab is Walking Announced
entries.summary: tinyBuild has announced Hypnohead's The Crab is Walking. Players build a settlement, produce resources, and raise an army within limited space on the back of a moving giant creature while confronting battles and events across the wasteland.
entries.verification: The packet opened only AUTOMATON, not a publisher or store page, so the item remains a media relay of the announcement.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve confirms Annihilation Battle’s return and reveals a story trailer
entries.summary: PlayStation Blog has revealed a new story trailer for Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve and confirmed the return of the series’ popular Annihilation Battle mode. The game is scheduled for release on October 2, 2026.
entries.verification: The first-party PlayStation Blog source was opened; claims are limited to information explicitly disclosed in its text.
entries.timeNote: PlayStation Blog’s publication time was converted to Beijing time and falls within this edition’s fixed window.

entries.headline: Marvel’s Wolverine developers discuss Logan’s design, claw combat, and characterization
entries.summary: In a PlayStation Blog interview, Insomniac Games developers discuss Logan’s character design, claw combat, the choice of allies and enemies, and actor Liam McIntyre’s role in shaping the character. Marvel’s Wolverine is scheduled to launch on PS5 on September 15.
entries.verification: The first-party PlayStation Blog developer interview was opened; no information beyond the interview is added.
entries.timeNote: PlayStation Blog’s publication time was converted to Beijing time and falls within this edition’s fixed window.

entries.headline: Late-night taxi horror game Road to Jukai announced for PC in 2027
entries.summary: tinyBuild and Endflame have officially announced the psychological horror game Road to Jukai. Players drive a late-night taxi in Japan, picking up passengers in a town surrounded by a cursed forest. Previously announced as Silent Road, the renamed game is planned for PC via Steam in 2027.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report relays tinyBuild and Endflame’s official announcement, the name change, platform, and planned 2027 release.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time was converted to Beijing time and falls within this edition’s fixed window.

entries.headline: Drill Core Anniversary Update arrives on PS5, Xbox Series, and PC, with Switch to follow
entries.summary: tinyBuild and Hungry Couch have released Drill Core’s Anniversary Update on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam. The Nintendo Switch version will follow later.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report relays the publisher’s and developer’s platform rollout for the anniversary update. The official Simplified Chinese Steam store title is used in the Chinese edition.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time was converted to Beijing time and falls within this edition’s fixed window.

entries.headline: SILENT HILL f wins the grand prize at Japan Horror Game Awards 2026
entries.summary: The Japan Horror Game Awards 2026, produced by 百室, have announced their winners, with SILENT HILL f receiving the grand prize.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer article records the results announced by the organizers. The Chinese title used is the established name in mainland Chinese gaming media.
entries.timeNote: The packet places this report within the edition’s fixed window, but the source gives no verifiable exact publication time, so timing is confirmed only to the date.

entries.headline: Rogue Braver | 勇者ローグ brings fast-paced turn-based roguelike play to Steam on October 31
entries.summary: Solo developer DORASA.NET has announced an October 31 Steam release for the turn-based roguelike Rogue Braver. It emphasizes convenience features such as fast movement and item-identification assistance, with a mobile version also planned for later.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON article records the developer’s announced October 31 Steam release plan and the game’s core design.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time was converted to Beijing time and falls within this edition’s fixed window.

entries.headline: Capcom to open its first U.S. merchandise pop-up store in Los Angeles
entries.summary: Capcom plans to open its first U.S. retail pop-up store in Los Angeles’ Little Tokyo on September 19, running through October 18. The store will sell merchandise and offer some visitors opportunities to try games including Mega Man: Dual Override.
entries.verification: The IGN article was opened. Only the location, operating dates, and on-site activities explicitly described in the report are used.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time was converted to Beijing time and falls within this edition’s fixed window.

entries.headline: Stephen Root confirms his involvement in Grand Theft Auto VI
entries.summary: Actor Stephen Root confirmed in an Associated Press interview that he is involved in Grand Theft Auto VI. Players had previously speculated that he voiced Brian Heder in the trailer; Rockstar had not yet officially announced its principal cast.
entries.verification: The opened IGN article directly relays Stephen Root’s confirmation in the Associated Press interview. Player speculation is not presented as an additional confirmed fact.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time was converted to Beijing time and falls within this edition’s fixed window.

entries.headline: Fortnite confirms a Kingdom Hearts crossover with Sora
entries.summary: Epic Games has teased a Fortnite crossover with Kingdom Hearts. Sora is confirmed as a skin, while accompanying text teasers also point to Riku, Kairi, and Roxas.
entries.verification: The opened IGN article is explicitly based on teasers from Fortnite’s official social account. The Chinese edition retains Tencent’s official mainland title for Fortnite.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time was converted to Beijing time and falls within this edition’s fixed window.

entries.headline: Lies of P sequel trademark clue points to the name Wonders of O
entries.summary: The name Wonders of O appears in trademark filings associated with NEOWIZ. IGN suggests it may relate to the Lies of P sequel in development, but the name has not been officially confirmed as the sequel’s title.
entries.verification: The IGN report was opened. The EUIPO trademark application is presented only as a naming clue, with the lack of official confirmation explicitly retained.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time was converted to Beijing time and falls within this edition’s fixed window.
